claim_ceiling: design/cases candidate only; not Builder admission, RED execution, engineering acceptance, MVP or Goal complete

runner_contract.compile: esbuild.transform source bytes to CJS in memory; vm allowlist loader; no drawChart/constructor/destroy body copies, source rewrites or universal Proxy
runner_contract.execution_error_policy: compiler/import/unknown seam/timeout/fixture invalid = execution_error; cannot count as expected RED
runner_contract.phase_projection: Only external resource-release calls occurring inside production destroy invocation and line catch; constructor acquisition/start pre-destroy calls have separate acquisition trace. Exact order/multiplicity; no dedup.

error_policy.business: reject same object/value E; no wrapper
error_policy.carousel_destroy: return void on clean; after all attempts throw first raw cleanup error, console.warn each remaining raw error once in attempt order
error_policy.constructor_and_line: consume destroy first error and warn it once, then rethrow business original; line G.destroy error warn once after C cleanup. Therefore multi-error warning order C[1:] then C[0] then G error.
error_policy.console_warn_failure: best effort swallow logger failure; no recursive reporting
error_policy.case_identity: raw fixture bytes + canonical cases array + runner bytes + input production bytes; freeze before RED, same runner/Cases for GREEN; production bytes may change only by approved Builder

fixture_rules: Every case gets fresh vm/module static state. Named DOM targets track exact callback and capture identity; native cleanup throws after effect unless case explicitly throw_before_effect.

Default successful start: visible H, valid rendered datum, production next executes, cooldown timer TQ returned. Tooltip scroll creation is suppressed by named schedule dependency unless case injects S; no universal Proxy.
LSC-025 starts with visible H then G.getContext throws inside next before cooldown timer allocation.

TS-private resource fields may be arranged/read via bracket access in transformed actual class only for inject_owned_resources and static-owner setups. Never replace constructor/start/destroy/stop/clearTimer/listener cleanup methods. Every injected field, callback, timer is recorded and validated before invocation.
Ordinary controls run production Line/common/Carousel; nonline controls instantiate same production Carousel with named chart shape, do not claim full nonline drawChart exception safety.

observation_spies.rule: Record entry then call saved compiled-production original exactly once with same this/args and return/throw unchanged. No fault injection or replacement control flow in these spies; constructor/start/destroy/stop/clearTimer remain unwrapped production bodies. Labels chart.restoreColumnSelectionAttributes:G/chart.clearInteractionBackgrounds:G identify Carousel helper entry using its G handle, not invented methods on NamedChart.

invariants: C lifecycle flags, listeners, observer, timer/frame/cancel/background refs consumed before external cleanup; reentrant destroy no-op
listener registration intent recorded before add using original target/handler/capture; thrown add may have applied
cache detach occurs at destroy entry before any reentrant cleanup primitive, only if cache.get(container)===this; old owner never deletes new owner; tail performs no container-key cache delete
global timers/listener state detached before remove/clear; release only cache empty; no container-key resize task deletion
never promise physical cleanup success after cleanup primitive throws-before-effect; record unresolved resources
G.destroy once for every returned G handle on drawChart failure; C constructor handles own partial resources before it can return
success no premature cleanup; caller owns returned G; empty no G allocation
real permissions and stage/query/Store/installer-before-return obligations remain open
write_exclusions: production or runner writes by this lane
